title: SimCity 4 Deluxe

engine.name: Maxis SC4 engine
engine.evidence: Apps/SimCity 4.exe (7.5 MB), Regions/ and Plugins/ content trees, Radio/ music, Fonts/, Sku_Data/; plugin architecture is the game's own documented extension point.
engine.notes: Deluxe bundles the Rush Hour expansion in one executable.

userState.evidence: publisher convention (the game writes Regions/Plugins under My Documents); directory not present on this machine yet

dependencies.endpoint: maxis.com (text only); WININET is imported for the in-game browser/help links
dependencies.evidence: string scan of Apps/SimCity 4.exe produced no service hostname other than maxis.com
dependencies.notes: No authentication, no telemetry, no content delivery. The executable is .bind-wrapped, so the absence of strings is weaker evidence than for an unwrapped binary.

staticAnalysis.method: PE header/import parse plus ASCII string scan
staticAnalysis.limits: Steam's .bind wrapper hides part of the executable; only the wrapper-visible strings were scanned.

notes: Expected to be the easiest full offline verification after PvZ: a single executable, local saves and a plugin folder that users already manage themselves.
